## Eastern Bank Announces NE Landscape Holding As A Commercial Banking Customer


November 17, 2026


*Provides comprehensive financing solution for working capital and business growth strategy*


BOSTON--(BUSINESS WIRE)--


[Eastern Bank](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.easternbank.com%2F&esheet=54642912&newsitemid=20261117977262&lan=en-US&anchor=Eastern+Bank&index=1&md5=bba0b3c280c68d91c8b2d88c912a90b2) **** is pleased to announce NE Landscape Holding (NELH), a full-service provider of landscaping services throughout Massachusetts and southern New Hampshire, as a new commercial banking customer. Founded by Anvil Capital, NELH acquires and grows leading landscaping service providers throughout New England. Its portfolio includes Leahy Landscaping and Lynch Landscape & Tree Service as well as the recently acquired Comak Brothers Landscaping, which provide commercial, municipal, and residential landscaping, tree care, composting, snow removal, and irrigation services. Eastern provided a credit package to refinance existing debt and support ongoing working capital, which includes a delayed draw facility to finance the acquisition of Comak Brothers Landscaping and regional expansion.


“We’re pleased to welcome NE Landscape Holding to Eastern,” said Greg Buscone, Executive Vice President and Chief Commercial Banking Officer of Eastern Bank. “The company is known for delivering quality landscaping services to a range of customers, and we look forward to supporting its plans for continued growth and expansion.”


“We are excited to work with Eastern Bank as we enter this next phase of growth,” said Ben Giess, Managing Partner of Anvil Capital. “Eastern took the time to understand our business and growth objectives, ultimately providing a financing solution that supports both our current operations and future expansion opportunities. Their support has been instrumental in helping us complete the acquisition of Comak Brothers Landscaping and continue advancing our long-term vision.”


Eastern Bank provides a range of commercial financing offerings to help companies across many industries improve cash flow, increase efficiencies, and build for the future. Commercial lending solutions include working capital/lines of credit, equipment/term loans, real estate loans, acquisition financing, asset-based lending, franchise lending, and employee stock ownership plan-related financing.


The Commercial Banking team advising NE Landscape Holding includes: Executive Vice President, Chief Commercial Banking Officer Greg Buscone; Commercial Group Director Brendan O’Neill; Senior Vice President and Commercial Banking Team Leader Joseph Alberghini; Vice President, Commercial Portfolio Manager Davis Foster; and Vice President, Treasury Services Sales Advisor Jennifer Bradbury-Wilson.


**About Eastern Bank** Founded in 1818, Eastern Bank is Greater Boston’s leading local bank with more than 125 branch locations serving communities in eastern Massachusetts, southern and coastal New Hampshire, and Rhode Island. As of September 30, 2026, Eastern had approximately $31.7 billion in assets. Eastern provides a full range of banking and wealth management solutions for consumers and businesses of all sizes including through its Cambridge Trust Wealth Management and Private Banking Divisions, which include the largest bank-owned independent investment adviser in Massachusetts with $10.8 billion in assets under management. Eastern takes pride in its advocacy and community support that includes more than $240 million in charitable giving since 1994. An inclusive company, Eastern is comprised of deeply committed professionals who value relationships with their customers, colleagues and communities.
